label.summary: Claims focus on the health and economic consequences of the COVID-19 pandemic, particularly for vulnerable populations. These include concerns about access to care for communities of color and the disproportionate impact on workers, poor people, and marginalized groups. The pandemic has also exposed existing racial and economic health disparities.
label.title: COVID-19 Pandemic: Health and Economic Impacts

claims.claim_text: The lack of guaranteed paid sick leave and paid family leave is catastrophic for public health in the midst of the COVID-19 pandemic.

With the COVID-19 outbreak and a looming economic recession, hospital workers, poor and unhoused people, the elderly, incarcerated people, the immunocompromised, immigrants, and other marginalized groups will likely bear the most impact.
Workers and poor people will be vulnerable to illness while being unable to afford treatment or even testing, endangering whole communities.
The COVID-19 pandemic has exposed major racial and economic health disparities in the United States.
By the 2021 adopted platform, COVID-19 has killed hundreds of thousands of people.
Communities of color have struggled to access life-saving care when they need it most during the COVID-19 pandemic.

prompt:

SUBJECT, not an ideology, shared stance, agreement, or independently verified fact.
Read all claims; acknowledge mixed subtopics or opposing positions. Do not invent
facts or infer positions for groups absent from the examples. If the claims mainly
concern political actors, campaign narratives, or organizing rather than a coherent
policy subject, say so plainly in both title and caveat. Party names can appear
only when the party itself is the subject. Avoid vague titles like 'Policy and Society'.

{"title": "specific subject, at most 9 words",
 "summary": "1-3 sentences describing subject and important variation",
 "caveat": "mixed-subtopic/stance caveat, or an empty string",

The keywords are retrieval aids, not additional factual evidence.
